citations.claim: body 1 overlaps wall 0 by >0.15 before tunneling
body 1 centre inside wall 0 at next step showing tunneling

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0323 to 0.005 to increase substeps and prevent tunneling through thin wall

explanation: Large dt=0.032 with fast body (speed ~26 m/s) causes insufficient substeps to resolve thin wall collision. Body 1 overlaps wall 0 at step 51 then tunnels through by step 52, changing vx sign incorrectly. Reducing dt resolves it.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 51 and 52

vision_note: In steps 49-51 the small red body sits just outside the right end of the thick low horizontal grey block and moves only a tiny distance. In step 52 it is visibly embedded inside the corner of that block rather than deflecting around it. [disagreement: The frames show a slow, short-range motion into a thick horizontal block, not a high-speed (~26 m/s) crossing of a thin vertical wall. Movement between tiles is minimal, contradicting insufficient-substep tunneling at large dt, and no sign flip / fast transit is visible.]
